description: Numeric-style concatenation of HHID and PN, with leading zeros removed; designed to resemble common HRS merge IDs such as 3010.
Nine-character HHID+PN identifier preserving all leading zeros.
Six-character household identification number, preserved as text.
Three-character respondent person number, preserved as text.
Harmonized WHO ANSWERED THE QUESTIONS source code. Only codes 1 and 2 are retained; source code 3, source code 9, and blank values are output as blank.
1 if the respondent has a row in that wave's LB respondent file; 0 otherwise.
Unchanged source value from KLB051, LLB051, MLB051, NLB085, OLB077, or PLB077. Retains codes such as 3 and 9.
Unchanged HRS RESPONDENT TYPE INDICATOR value from XLBRTYPE. This is distinct from the WHO ANSWERED THE QUESTIONS item.
Unchanged Leave-Behind eligibility value from XLBELIG.
Unchanged Leave-Behind questionnaire completion-mode value from XLBCOMP.
Number of the six LB source files in which the respondent has a record.
Number of waves in which respondent_type_wN equals 1 or 2.
Number of retained respondent-type values equal to 1.
Number of retained respondent-type values equal to 2.
Earliest and latest HRS wave with an LB source-file record for this respondent.
